product_metadata.title: MyGift Wooden Log-Pillar Design Tealight Candle Holder with 5 Clear Glass Votive
features: 5-PILLARS: 5 varying height vertical wooden logs created into a unique candle holder. (Logs are attached).
TEALIGHT CANDLE HOLDERS: 5 clear glass votives can be removed for planting or lighting candles.
NATURAL DECOR: Perfect addition to any wedding centerpiece, fireplace mantel, or bathroom for a relaxing environment.
MULTI-USE: Great for tea light candles, air plants, faux succulents and flowers or other decorative items.
SPECS: 2.8 - 7.8 H X 13.8 W X 2.0 D; Each Votive - 1.8 H X 2.5 Diameter (in inches). Sizes of the wooden logs are unique with each arrangement and may vary slightly.
description: Rustic wood logs and clear glass votive create the perfect setting for romantic, natural and relaxing decors. Five varying height logs, each contain a hole in the top for the removable glass votives, ideal for holding tea light candles, real or artificial succulent plants, and other decorative items. So whether your decorating for a wedding or event, planning a romantic dinner or simply decorative your fireplace mantel, this unique wooden candle holder set will create the ideal mood.
SPECS: 2.8 - 7.8 H X 13.8 W X 2.0 D; Each Votive - 1.8 H X 2.5 Diameter (in inches). ***Sizes of the wooden logs are unique with each arrangement and may have slight variation.
